item.title: Building Digital Capabilities for Improved ESG Performance of Entrepreneurial Firms: Strategies for Tackling Challenges and Capitalizing on Opportunities
item.content:encoded:
Stefano Bresciani, University of Torino

Jawad Abbas, James Cook University

Fauzia Jabeen, Abu Dhabi University

This collection addresses how entrepreneurial firms develop digital capabilities to enhance their environmental, social, and governance performance. In a rapidly evolving technological landscape, entrepreneurial ventures must strategically build digital competencies to maintain competitive advantage while advancing sustainable and ethical business practices.

The collection explores the interconnection between digital innovation and ESG performance in entrepreneurial contexts. It welcomes experimental, conceptual, theoretical, and empirical studies examining how digital capabilities contribute to environmental responsibility, social sustainability, and improved governance structures in entrepreneurial firms, while identifying challenges and solutions in this integration.

The collection invites scholars to investigate multiple dimensions of this convergence, including how firms measure ESG performance digitally, address sustainability challenges through technology, foster knowledge-sharing ecosystems, leverage digital tools for transparency, and balance profitability with sustainable practices in their operations.

  • Digital capabilities and ESG performance
  • ESG measurement and definition in digital era
  • Digital solutions for environmental sustainability
  • Learning mechanisms and knowledge-sharing in entrepreneurial ecosystems
  • Leadership and organizational culture for digital ESG
  • Digital technologies for environmental performance measurement
  • Digital capabilities for diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Digitalization and governance structures
  • Regulatory frameworks and ESG compliance
  • Digital transparency and accountability in ESG reporting
  • Profitability and sustainable practices through digital transformation
  • Real-world cases of digital capabilities and ESG impact

item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, }],

This multi-journal collection brings together research on entrepreneurship as a mechanism for addressing major global challenges. The collection welcomes cross-disciplinary contributions from researchers, practitioners, and policymakers examining how entrepreneurial activities generate expected and realized changes across different contexts and their implications.

Papers in the collection investigate entrepreneurship's impact on shaping the future by analyzing phenomena at micro, meso, and macro levels of analysis. Submissions are welcomed across three participating journals with varying disciplinary focuses: international entrepreneurship contexts, entrepreneurship in diverse organizational settings, and global entrepreneurship phenomena.
